title: Seventy-Two Hours

mood.label: Uneasy talks
mood.summary: First wartime US envoy visit to Kyiv buys a 72-hour pause on the capitals, but nothing is signed — and Hormuz, Lebanon, Colombia, five thousand missing in Nepal and a record AfD vote all hold their ground.

style.genre: neo-soul groove — clavinet, trombone, upright bass

lines: Two men flew into Kyiv with nothing in their hands,
seventy-two hours where the capitals stay quiet.
They called the talking substantive. They didn't call it peace.
Nobody signed a thing, and the rest of the map stayed violent.
Hormuz is drawing new lines through the water,
four in Lebanon, three at Ocaña in the dark.
Twelve days on, five thousand still missing under the ice-melt —
Give me seventy-two hours, I'll take the quiet where it comes.
The Nikkei's up two, the smoke's over Borneo,
a kid found a fungus that can clean the sea.
Forty-three out of a hundred. Hold the line, let it go.
